classified_object.notes: The classified object is the Cube Community Beat Saber World Cup contest format, not Beat Saber as an entire product category or all rhythm games.

performance_agency.summary: Players execute tracked hand and upper-body movements live; in-game score depends on timing and motion during each map.

performance_interface.summary: Headset and tracked controllers translate bodily movement into the game.

embodied_performance.summary: Tracked movement, sensorimotor coordination, fine motor control, and sustained effort materially affect score.

arena.summary: A computational map presents timed targets and obstacles that structure action.

distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Tournament software, map timing, score submission, and communications coordinate the contest.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Hardware and tracking equivalence remain imperfect.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Software and tournament staff administer results and disputes.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Physical play-space safety remains local to each competitor.

sensing_tracking.summary: Headset and controller tracking are constitutive inputs.

measurement.summary: The in-game scoring system and tournament aggregation determine map and match results.

comparability.summary: Tournament rules constrain versions and prohibited mods, but hardware, tracking, latency, and map differences remain active comparability risks.

officiation.summary: Tournament staff, Tournament Assistant, streams, and published procedures administer matches.

outcome_openness.summary: Scores emerge through live performance under map constraints.

consequence_structure.summary: Map wins, match progression, placement, and prizes derive from the contest.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Embodied live performance and a rule-bearing computational arena are jointly constitutive. Contest governance exists, although it is community- rather than federation-based.

human_limits_accessibility.note: Fatigue, room safety, and hardware access matter.

source_provisional_finding.summary: The contest provisionally satisfies the Spatial Athletic Contest structure even though broader sport recognition remains unsettled. System membership and institutional sport status are separate questions.

content: Evidence that tracked bodily input is incidental rather than causally necessary.
Rules showing uncontrolled or non-comparable scoring across participants.

evidence_sources.source_title: Beat Saber World Cup 2022 — Rules and Match Flow
